svg.title: Suriyaprakash Palanisamy - Senior Software Engineer
svg.desc: Holographic HUD header. A rotating dot-matrix Earth with depth (far-side dots glimmer through the glass), orbit rings, city nodes and data arcs sits beside the name Suriyaprakash Palanisamy, Senior Software Engineer: Backend, Cloud, ML platforms, AI-driven development. Now at Freddie Mac on an ML forecasting platform, building FastAPI microservices on AWS EKS/ECS. McLean, VA.
